assign.card: ext/tabs: the Tabs page loads with no error

set.title: ext/tabs: the page throws 'Invalid base URL' and links to /ext/tabs/undefinedwhy/
set.text: Seen 2026-10-23 by mastermind-page: Server/smoke.mjs on worktree/merge-list-module-tasks (michael/dev at 3940d1b1c) fails /framework/ext/tabs/ and every tab under it with pageerror "Failed to construct 'URL': Invalid base URL", and the in-page tab demos (page.js:19-65, this.tabs("what why") / "state notes") link to /framework/ext/tabs/undefinedwhy/ and /undefinednotes/: a demo page's url is undefined when its tabs build their links. Reproduce on current michael/dev first. Tabs are the third navigation level (core/Page/navigation), so it is this queue's.

log.msg: Before: smoke on /framework/ext/tabs/ = 19 FAIL, all 'Failed to construct URL: Invalid base URL' at core/Page/settings/settings.js:115 (via Jsonl.js:179 nav_ready) plus /undefinedwhy/ and /undefinednotes/ links. Cause: the two demo roots in ext/tabs/page.js have title:"" so Page.naming() (Page.class.js:251) leaves url undefined; tabs.js:79 then builds undefined+name.

decision.msg: Fix in ext/tabs (page.js: url on each demo root; tabs.js: call app.mark?.() after draw_bar so a demo.app box un-hrefs late-built tab links). Alternative: make Page.naming() or DemoApp default a url for a titleless root; declined, touches core for every page.

After: ext/tabs, Doc, core/Page smoke = 3 FAIL, none in ext/tabs: Panel (layout text touching, already failing before), and two sessions ?tab=coverage pages linked from Doc (outside scope). Demo tab links now data-demo-url=/tabs-demo/, /tabs-demo/why/, /tabs-demo-block/, /tabs-demo-block/notes/ with no href. Shot: C:/Users/mike/AppData/Local/Temp/tabs-after.png

log.msg: ready: worktree/ext-tabs at 613bad36b ext/tabs demo roots get a url; demo tabs un-href'd

findings.text: Requirement 4 asks for a 1920 shot "showing both demos with their tab bars", but the shot shows only the first demo (shots/127-0-0-1-62645-framework-ext-tabs/1920.png, viewport ends below demo 1). The `block` demo (/tabs-demo-block/) is not shown, so its fix is unproven by the shots; only the session log's `data-demo-url` values vouch for it.

Both demo panels render empty under the selected "what" tab (sheet.png, 1920 and 400, demo box below the tab bar): the md text "This panel is a real page..." is not visible. Blank may be the fixed 10em height clipping, or the child not mounting; the owner cannot tell from the shot that the tab content works.

The demo tab links carry `data-demo-url` and no `href` (session.jsonl "After" line). That matches the demo box's design, but "link to real urls" is met only as data attributes, not as clickable hrefs.

The change adds a second `mark` call (tabs.js `this.app?.mark?.()`) beside `router.mark_links()`. It is one line, but the comment names a demo case inside the real-page tabs code path, so a real page whose `app` has a `mark` would also run it.

Smoke after: 3 FAIL remain in the three-page set (Panel text touching, two sessions ?tab=coverage links from Doc). The log says none are in ext/tabs and Panel failed before; I could not verify this from the shots.

log.msg: Review fix 1: panel mounted fine (DOM had the p, clicking why/notes swaps text at 400 and 1920) but the demo box is style height 10em = 125px, and the tab panel needs 155-213px, so the text sat below the clipped edge (ext/tabs/page.js lines 29 and 66). It was already clipped on michael/dev; the url error just hid it. Set both to 16em. Shots with text visible: public/framework/ext/tabs/doc/demo-what-why-1920.png, demo-block-1920.png. Smoke /framework/ext/tabs/ = 0 FAIL.
ready: worktree/ext-tabs at 25aff21a4 demo boxes 16em so panel text shows; both demos shot

review answered by mastermind-page. 1 done (25aff21a4: doc/demo-what-why-1920.png and demo-block-1920.png show both demos and their tab bars). 2 done (panels were clipped by the 10em demo height, page.js:29,66; 16em shows the text, checked in both shots). 3 kept: a demo box never carries a crawlable href by design; data-demo-url is its link. 4 kept: only DemoApp defines mark() (ext/demo/app.js:188), so the line does nothing on a real page. 5 kept: the 3 FAIL are outside ext/tabs and failed before; /framework/ext/tabs/ smokes 0 FAIL.
